The engine has a black plastic intake manifold and a large black air intake hose on the right side.

No visible branding or model tags are readable on the engine block or components in either photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Complete engine Passat Cc TSI SE Audi A4 A5 TSI', but no visual evidence confirms any of these models.

response.reason: The engine cannot be identified by brand or model from the photos. The seller's claim is unverifiable remotely. Without proof of model, condition, and legal status, a reliable price cannot be assigned. The item must be verified before pricing.
